resources.string: Choose different PINs of 6–12 digits. Remember both PINs; Veil cannot recover them. Long press the home clock to open the PIN entry. Long press Search for Emergency Veil.
Unable to open. Check your PIN or try again later.
Use distinct PINs of 6–12 digits and matching confirmations.
Configuration unavailable. Apps remain concealed. Use Android Home settings to choose another launcher; reinstalling Veil resets only its own configuration.
Requires Android 15+, default Home role and an available private profile.
Android did not confirm a private-space lock. Veil still conceals its apps locally.
Android may require authentication. Return here after completing it.

Veil conceals apps inside this launcher. STANDARD does not hide them from Android Settings, notifications, Recents, USB/ADB or other launchers. Private Space provides OS isolation when supported and locked. MANAGED requires deliberate device-owner provisioning and is not enabled by this build. No automatic data wiping or PIN recovery.
Local utility notes only. Do not enter sensitive information.
A familiar home screen, with separate app choices for each PIN. Set it up in three simple steps.
Your private PIN opens your apps and the controls for Veil.
A different PIN opens only the apps you choose, with local Settings and utilities.
Veil PINs work inside this launcher. Your Android screen-lock PIN stays separate. No automatic data deletion.
Choose the PIN you will use to open your everyday apps. Enter it again to confirm.
Use a different PIN for the alternative home. You choose its apps after setup.
Your private home shows your installed apps. The alternative starts with Calculator, Notes, Clock and local Settings. Add its everyday apps from App visibility and disguises.
Hold the home clock to enter a PIN. Hold Search to switch immediately to the alternative home.
Choose apps for each PIN, change how they look, and keep your private controls here.
Change the PINs for your homes
Choose when your private session locks
Open Veil when you press Home
Tap an app to choose whether it appears here, its displayed name, icon and destination.
Uses the original name and icon, and opens the real app.
Does not appear in the home screen or Veil search for this profile.
Uses your chosen name and icon, but opens the real app.
Uses your chosen name and icon, and opens a local utility instead of the real app.
Private apps appear here after Android unlocks the space.

Hold the clock at the top of your home to enter a PIN. Your private PIN opens your private apps and controls. Your alternative PIN opens the ordinary-looking home. Veil PINs do not change your Android screen lock.

Choose the apps you want in the alternative home. Open an app row, enable Allow in this profile, choose its appearance and save. Until you add apps, this home contains Calculator, Notes, Clock and local Settings.

Real: original app and icon. Hidden: absent from this Veil home and search. Disguised: another name and utility icon, opening the real app. Decoy: another name and icon, opening a local utility instead. Names and icons change inside Veil only.

Open alternative home or Lock Veil ends your private session. Hold home search for Emergency Veil when enabled. To return, hold the home clock and enter your private PIN. Restarting or recreating Veil returns to the alternative home.

Alternative Settings opens local ordinary controls. Android Settings, notifications, recent apps and other system screens remain accessible outside Veil in Standard mode. Private Space provides stronger separation on supported devices after Android setup.
